Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage.provider.mysql

Class MysqlStorageProvider

java.lang.Object
com.skyblockexp.ezframework.storage.provider.mysql.MysqlStorageProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
QueryableStorage, MigrationCapable, JdbcStorage, StorageProvider
public class MysqlStorageProvider extends Object implements StorageProvider, MigrationCapable, QueryableStorage, JdbcStorage
Minimal MySQL-backed StorageProvider. Configuration (via plugin config): - mysql.host (default: localhost) - mysql.port (default: 3306) - mysql.database (required) - mysql.user (required) - mysql.password (optional)
